title: fix: add DeepInfra fallback for Kimi K3
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Fixes upstream rate-limit failures with hidden `moonshotai/kimi-k3:deepinfra`, using the shared fallback mechanism and exact upstream `moonshotai/Kimi-K3` at `https://api.deepinfra.com/v1/openai`.
- Keeps Fireworks primary, canonical `moonshotai/kimi-k3`, alias `kimi-k3`, multiplier 1, Quest access (`paidOnly: false`), external hardware, 1M context, vision and tools. Caller prices remain $3/$0.30/$15 per million input/cached/output tokens; [DeepInfra costs](https://deepinfra.com/moonshotai/Kimi-K3/api) are $2.85/$0.285/$14.25. Novita needs cache-write accounting corrections.
- Omits null optional `name`/`tool_calls` response fields so clients can reuse assistant messages directly. Adds response-reuse and fallback-billing regressions.
- Verifies direct calls, production-primary smoke and forced-fallback local E2E: native/chat endpoints, aliases, Quest-only access, streaming usage, reasoning, tools/raw-message reuse, JSON/schema, 1/2/10 images, prompt/output caches, errors, hidden catalogs and 10 concurrent requests. Default-effort coding completed in 31 seconds.
- Passes 145 focused Gen tests, the Enter price snapshot, Gen typecheck and Biome. Staging telemetry records 34 once-billed DeepInfra successes and 34 unbilled primary failures (30 forced 429s, four network failures). All 23 non-overlapping wallet checks match the public quote; no missing conversion warnings.

gist.headline: Kimi gets a second route
gist.blurb: When Fireworks rate-limits Kimi K3, a hidden DeepInfra route gives the request somewhere else to go. The detour keeps the same model and caller pricing.
gist.summary: Kimi K3 keeps Fireworks as its primary provider and gains a hidden DeepInfra fallback for upstream failures, with once-only billing and null optional response fields omitted so clients can reuse assistant messages.
gist.impact: Calls to moonshotai/kimi-k3 or its kimi-k3 alias can fall back to DeepInfra on a primary-provider failure while retaining the $3/$0.30/$15 per-million-token input/cached/output prices.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Kimi K3 as a small retro terminal in a garden, with a primary Fireworks path and a sheltered DeepInfra path converging on it. Polli, wearing a tiny route-planner hat, gently guides the monitor robot carrying a chat message along the alternate path; a single Pollen token beside the terminal represents once-only billing.
